ValidationRule.description: Marketing Child Mandatory fields for status Completed based on the CurrencyIsoCode Fields: Actual Cost in Campaign Actual Revenue in Campaign
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Marketing_Child", OR(ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "KHR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "IDR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "KRW"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "MYR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "PGK"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "PHP"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "SBD"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "BHD"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "VND")), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Completed"), OR( ISBLANK ( ActualCost ), ActualCost = 0), OR( ISBLANK ( Actual_Revenue_in_Campaign__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please either add your Actual Cost in your Campaign Expenses list or fill up your Actual Revenue in Campaign
